data.desc: Veea Inc. (NASDAQ: VEEA) is a global leader in edge solutions and infrastructure. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, Veea enables enterprises, service providers and public sector organizations to deploy AI-powered applications at the edge. The VeeaONE platform integrates connectivity, computing, cybersecurity and storage into a unified hyperconverged network solution, from edge to cloud. Veea holds more than 123 patents across related technology domains and has been recognized by Gartner for its innovations in edge computing. www.veea.
